Plant Needs
Plant transport system (Plant vascular system)
It is a system of vessels (tubes) that transports water, nutrients and plant food
(glucose) between the plant parts.
Its structure :
- It consists of :
* Xylem. * Phloem.

Note
The transport system in plants has one-way vessels that move important substances
between the parts of the plant.
+ From the previous explanation, we can conclude the similarities between the
transport system in plants and circulatory system in humans, which are :
- Both have vessels to transport water, nutrients and gases.
- Both have one-way vessels (tubes).
